alexcrichton opened PR #15257 from alexcrichton:document-dropping-hooks to bytecodealliance:main:

In the event of dropping future or cancelling some wasm the call hook events emitted may not be perfectly balanced because dropping a fiber doesn't run any user-specified code. Be sure to document this caveat.
